Cortech Super 2.0 12-Liter Magnetic Tank Bag

The Cortech Super 2.0 12L Tank Bag is the Goldilocks of tank bags. Not too big nor too small, it's right sized to hold when you need when you hit the roads. Constructed from 1680D ballistic polyester and 1800D three-lined twill Jacquard fabric exterior, the interior consists of soft, two-toned liner. When you are ready to take the tank bag with you off the bike, release the hidden backpack straps or use the handy rubber carry strap. The Cortech Super 2.0 12 Liter Tank Bag is a great solution for your carrying needs.

Features:

  • 1680 denier ballistic polyester and 1800 denier three-lined twill Jacquard construction
  • Protective non-slip, non-scratch diamond pattern mounting base
  • One-way zipper on main compartment with a “Zipper Garage” for concealment
  • Top flap internal organizer and soft lining
  • Hideaway backpack straps
  • Removable and replaceable snapped map pocket
  • Two internal mesh storage pockets
  • Hidden external pocket for miscellaneous storage
  • Phoslite® reflective piping
  • Built-in sip tube and headphone exit ports
  • Integrated stowaway rain cover with clear window included
  • Two-tone red and black soft lining interior

Cortech Apex 2.0 Pants

Just like the name suggests, the Cortech Apex 2.0 Leather Pants are ready to hit the apices and apogees. The mesh lining increases air circulation, keeping you cooler so you can ride longer. The accordion stretch panels at knees and waist along with stretch nylon panels in the inseam and calves allow increased flexibility and performance fit. Attach the Cortech Apex 2.0 Pants to the Cortech Latigo 2.0 Jacket or the Adrenaline Jacket, and you are ready to hit the track.

Fit:
  • Athletic
  • Runs large, select 1 size smaller than the size chart suggests

Features:

  • Constructed with a combination of 1.2mm to 1.4mm perforated and non-perforated top grade drum dyed leather
  • Removable CE-approved knee armor and soft hip armor
  • Triple and double-stitched with high strength bonded nylon thread
  • Accordion-style expansion panels at knees and waist for increased flexibility and a performance fit
  • Heavy duty, 600 denier stretch nylon panels in the inseam and calves for ease of movement
  • Pre-Curved knees for comfort and performance in the riding position
  • Optional knee slider attachment (slider sold separately)
  • Mesh lining throughout enhances air circulation and comfort
  • Features a full-circumference and 8-inch pant to jacket attachment zipper with the jacket sides included
  • Elastic waist helps to fine tune the fit
  • Pairs with Cortech Adrenaline and Latigo 2.0 jackets
  • YKK zippers
